title: Book Two · Chapter 109: The Wet Corner
story:
The younger boy brings Jun's tree book back on Thursday morning. He carries it with both hands. A dark patch runs across the bottom corner.

“I am sorry,” he says. “My bag got wet.”

Jun opens the book carefully. Two pages cling together near the corner. He stops. He does not try to pull them apart.

“Leave them,” Ronan says. “They may tear.”

Jun closes the cover halfway.

“I know.”

The boy looks from one face to the other. “Can I buy another?”

Jun looks at the book. “Let us ask about these pages first.”

Ronan wants to say the rain is not his fault. Nobody has said it is. He puts his hands behind his back.

At the reading room, Miss Wu lays clean dry paper under the book. She leaves a small space between the wet pages. Air can reach them there.

“We will let it dry slowly,” she says. “It may keep this mark.”

The younger boy repeats his apology. Jun tells him to bring his bag indoors during heavy rain. Then the boy goes to class.

Miss Wu looks at the two older boys.

“Why was he waiting in the passage yesterday?”

“The guide gives Wednesday,” Jun says.

“Who checked the time?”

Ronan looks at her hands beside the book.

“I copied an old sheet.”

“You told me you checked with the teacher.”

“Yes.”

“Did you?”

“No.”

Jun moves his bag from the chair. He does not speak.

Miss Wu waits. Ronan can hear pupils on the stairs. The sounds rise and fall behind the door.

“I read the new notice on Tuesday,” he says.

“Before the pupils went there on Wednesday?”

“Yes. I knew the right day then.”

Jun's head comes up.

“You knew before I took the book?”

Ronan nods.

Miss Wu puts a plain cover over the tree book. The cover will keep dust away.

“Come here after your last lesson,” she says. “Bring the old sheet, the guide, and your notes. First, we must tell the pupils the right time.”

Ronan reaches for his introduction card. He takes it from the guide and places it on the table.

Miss Wu leaves it there.

Jun picks up his bag. At the door, Ronan says his name.

Jun stops. He keeps his back to Ronan.

“I am sorry.”

“I asked you.”

“I know.”

“No. You keep saying you know. I asked before we made the copies.”

Jun walks away.

Ronan stays long enough to put the desk guides in Miss Wu's hand. She writes WRONG TIME across the front of both. The letters cover part of his careful title. She asks him to bring the remaining copies, too.

There are no copies left in his bag. Eighteen are already with other people.

## 词句提示

patch＝一块痕迹；cling＝粘住；dust＝灰尘；carefully＝小心地。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan向老师承认了哪两件事？
2. 书页受潮后为什么不马上硬拉开？

## 读句子

**Jun / picks up / his bag.** Jun／拿起／他的包。
